note: CANDIDATE RULE BACKLOG ONLY — NOT LEGALLY VERIFIED. Ship first verified 8–12 only after legal review; disabled rules never produce findings. No rule in this file has been reviewed or signed off by a lawyer: every entry has reviewer=null and reviewed_at=null, and no entry may be marked enabled until its source wording, severity and reviewer are recorded. Source: Sign Se Pehle Final PRD & Technical Report (24 Oct 2026), Uttarakhand rule registry, 22 candidates. Legal anchors: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA) and Uttarakhand RERA (General) Rules, 2017.
